description: Canonical machine-readable policy for the supervisor orchestration overlay: delegation depth, specialist allow-list, task routing, write-set discipline, and high-risk approval boundaries.

approvalRequiredCategories.description: Changes to architectural layers, boundaries, public contracts, or module shape.
Changes to starter or repository governance assets such as AGENTS.md, tool-access.json, agent policy, module composition, validators, or architecture contracts.
Adding, removing, or materially changing a dependency, framework, runtime, build tool, or infrastructure component.
Database or schema migrations, data transformations, or any change that can destroy or irreversibly rewrite data.
Changes to authentication, authorization, secrets, permissions, identity, security controls, or trust boundaries.
Changes to deployment, production infrastructure, networking, CI/CD, release behavior, or runtime configuration.
Commands or operations that delete, prune, force-reset, overwrite history, or otherwise destroy state.
Work that grows beyond the requested slice or the declared write set.

complexIfAny: Changes more than one architectural layer or independently owned subsystem.
Requires an architecture or public-contract decision.
Adds, removes, or materially changes a dependency, framework, runtime, build tool, or infrastructure component.
Requires a database or schema migration or a data transformation.
Changes authentication, authorization, secrets, permissions, identity, security controls, or trust boundaries.
Changes deployment, production infrastructure, networking, CI/CD, release behavior, or runtime configuration.
Modifies starter or core governance assets such as AGENTS.md, tool-access.json, agent policy, module composition, validators, or architecture contracts.
Has incomplete, conflicting, or design-dependent acceptance criteria.
Cannot be bounded to a sufficiently narrow implementation scope or write set.
complexityRouting.complexWorkflow: delegation-supervisor -> parallel read-only analysis -> consolidated plan -> human approval when required -> implementer -> parallel independent verification -> one consolidated repair pass if needed

enforcement.note: This policy is a governance expectation and a behavioral contract. No repository hook validates agent-to-agent delegation, and no trusted identity source or enforcement point exists for these approvals. Documentation must not describe this gate as enforced authorization.

approvalOverlayComposition.whenBothEnabled: reuse the approval-gated transition envelope rather than defining a second approval experience
approvalOverlayComposition.whenApprovalOverlayAbsent: the supervisor still stops at the mandatory high-risk checkpoint

fallbackWhenDelegationUnavailable.note: If the runtime cannot delegate subagents, the supervisor emits an ordered plan for the user to execute or refuses the delegation. It must not pretend delegation occurred.

deferredProposal.description: Move a universal minimum high-risk approval contract into core governance so guided and supervisor workflows inherit it. Requires its own ADR and must not be bundled into the supervisor overlay.
